body: A master key lies across a folded departure notice; the hall door was logged locked before the bus left, though a margin says it stood open. The custodian has underlined “return key” twice.
title: The key return

body: The caretaker says the grounds crew borrowed the kitchen sink for a rinse. Please keep the side room locked until the treated beds are dry; the folding chairs are still needed tomorrow.
title: Before the beds dry
